d: The Louvre in Paris has the Mona Lisa. New York’s Met is one of the world’s most celebrated museums. But on a new global ranking, an Indian museum has placed ahead of both. The Bihar Museum in Patna has ranked ninth on the World’s 100 Best Museums list, ahead of the Met at number 10 and the Louvre at number 31. It is also the highest-ranked museum in Asia on this list. Can the Bihar Museum become a blueprint for preserving India’s past? Palki Sharma tells you.
